note: Re-judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge after 87b04ed6cd. RFC 7296 2.21.4: "A peer receiving such an unprotected Notify payload MUST NOT respond and MUST NOT change the state of any existing SAs." This row keeps the state clause (MUST NOT respond is RFC7296-2.21.4-5). The defect the previous verdict named is fixed at the producer: handleAuthResponse and handleEAPResponse (fsm.go) now return on an IKE_AUTH response with no SK payload before touching the SA, where they used to set StateDead. The new TestErrUnprotectedNotifyLeavesHalfOpenSA uses the bytes sendInvalidIKESPI writes (asserted: IKE_AUTH, R bit, one unprotected INVALID_IKE_SPI Notify), delivers them through routeInbound to an initiator SA (newInitiatorSA via testSAWithKeys) in StateAuthSent and in StateEAPInProgress, and asserts no datagram before a sentinel and State, NextMsgID, ExpectedMsgID, RetransmitTime, RetransmitCount and the EAP session unchanged. The mutant record restoring StateDead in the handleAuthResponse drop is observed red; the EAP subtest has no record, but read at the producer handleInbound's StateEAPInProgress arm reaches handleEAPResponse for this input, so a StateDead there fails the State assertion. The handshake arms read no Message ID before the SK check, so the message ID the test picks (sa.NextMsgID) does not weaken it. The established route stays as judged before: TestErrUnprotectedNotifyChangesNoState (positive, unit unchanged) with its SK-protected negative at the same R bit and Message ID, both polarities with mutant records on the inboundInvalid decrypt condition in handleOwnedInbound. Other routes, read at the producer: handleOwnedInbound drops every unprotected message silently (decryptAndParse fails on no SK); handleResponderInbound returns before its state switch on any message with the R bit, which TestNrsResponseNeverDrawsAResponse (tagged RFC7296-3.1-12) pins, untagged here; the initiator StateSAInitSent arm kills the attempt on an IKE_SA_INIT response holding only an error notify, which Section 2.21.1 sanctions ("In an IKE_SA_INIT exchange, any error notification causes the exchange to fail.") and which no keyed SA yet exists for. Residual outside this row: a half-open initiator SA still goes StateDead when an SK payload is present but fails decryption (handleAuthResponse and handleEAPResponse, 'decryption failed'), a forged-SK case, not an unprotected Notify.
